Wildfire Map Spotlight: Colwash Fire, Washington

2026-08-24 IQAir Staff Writers wildfire map, Colwash Fire, Washington, Yakima County, Benton County, evacuation, air quality, GIS mapping
Read the source article

Quick summary

IQAir's wildfire map spotlight covers the Colwash Fire burning across Yakima and Benton counties in south-central Washington, which has consumed nearly 39,000 acres with only 8% containment as of August 24, 2026.

Key takeaways

  • The Colwash Fire spans Yakima and Benton counties in south-central Washington state
  • As of August 24, 2026, the fire has burned 38,708.9 acres and is 8% contained
  • Level 3 "Go" evacuation orders are in effect for areas in both Benton and Yakima counties
  • Level 2 "Set" warnings and Level 1 "Ready" notices cover surrounding areas
  • An American Red Cross evacuation shelter has been established at Prosser High School
  • The fire affects areas near Mabton, State Routes 22 and 221, Glade Road, and Byron Hill Road
  • Real-time air quality monitoring and wildfire maps are critical tools for public safety
